outcome: Pain and tenderness over the lumbar area
cohort: 300 patients undergoing emergency or elective Caesarean section under spinal anaesthesia.
finding: The incidence of post dural puncture backache decreased from 83% on day 1 to 1.3% at 3 months, with most cases resolving within a month.
mod_finding: There was no association between the spinal needle size used for dural puncture and the development of chronic backache.
